name: h3-storyboard
title_zh: 剧本进 H3 分镜前先算好每颗镜头能装几个情绪节拍
tagline_zh: 写分镜最怕情绪戏拍出来像木头。它把剧本拆成节拍表，标好每颗镜头几秒、脸往哪转、用哪种表演技法。
tagline_en: Stop writing H3 prompts that render wooden faces. This breaks your script into beat tables with shot counts.
desc_en: Turn a script into MiniMax H3 shot lists with working emotional performance — beat tables, shot counts, expression direction, and the acting techniques that actually render. Use when breaking a script or scene into H3 shots, writing beat timings, directing a character's face or emotion, fixing flat/wooden performance, deciding shot length or how many beats a shot can hold, or writing prompts for e
why_zh: 它不给你泛泛的镜头建议，而是把表演技法写进提示词——节拍时长、面部朝向、情绪转折点都量化。
why_en: It quantifies what other tools leave vague: beat durations, face angles, emotional pivots. Every prompt is built so H3's.
limit_zh: 只认 MiniMax H3 的提示词格式，不输出通用分镜脚本；需要你先有完整剧本或场景文本，不能从零生成故事。
limit_en: Only outputs MiniMax H3 prompt format, not generic storyboards. Requires a finished script/scene as input—no story generation. No camera movement or.
title_en: Script to H3 shot lists with beats that actually render
